checks.note: Docs show only a Google user access token via gcloud auth login and Bearer header; service accounts not mentioned. OAuth2 (Google user token) is a reasonable label; the 'Bearer token' label would also fit. Service-account support is not settled.

Page states a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license and roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser are required, and the API is Preview (Pre-GA, v1alpha). Licenses are subscriptions (paid). Pricing/tier not verified. Subscription minimum (15 licenses) comes from a forum post only.

REST over Discovery Engine v1alpha. Notebooks: create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete, share. Sources: batchCreate, uploadFile, get, batchDelete. No chat/query endpoint on these pages. 'narrow' fits.

PyPI package notebooklm-enterprise-mcp is a community fork (Robiton), explicitly not official Google. No official Google MCP for this API was found. The evidence mcp field was null, so the PyPI URL is now cited.

ready_with_caveats is consistent: paid per-user license, Pre-GA v1alpha, user-token auth only, no chat endpoint. Arguably close to blocked for unattended agents, but programmatic access works with a licensed user.

corrected.one_liner: NotebookLM Enterprise (Gemini Notebook Enterprise) is Google Cloud's source-grounded AI notebook for summarizing and querying uploaded documents, with a Discovery Engine REST API for managing notebooks and sources.
corrected.auth_notes: Docs show only a Google user access token (gcloud auth login, then Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)). That is a Google OAuth2 user token. Docs require an authenticated user account with a Gemini Notebook Enterprise license. Service accounts are not mentioned, and no third-party OAuth app flow or scopes are documented on the pages fetched. Drive sources need gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access. A standard Google OAuth client could probably mint the same token, but the docs do not state that, so this is an inference.
corrected.access_notes: Requires a Google Cloud project with Gemini Notebook Enterprise set up, a purchased license (subscription) assigned to the calling user, and the roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser role. Pricing was not verified. A forum post claims a 15-license minimum, which is unverified. The consumer NotebookLM has no documented public API. The API is Preview (Pre-GA, v1alpha). No allowlist mention found.
corrected.blocker: Paid per-user license required. The API is Pre-GA v1alpha with limited support and may change. Auth is a per-user Google token and service accounts are not documented, which makes unattended agents harder. Coverage is notebooks (create, get, listRecentlyViewed, batchDelete, share) and sources (batchCreate, uploadFile, get, batchDelete). No chat or query endpoint is documented on these pages. The MCP server is a single-maintainer community fork.
